author: aditsangani (AI-assisted)
summary: Prepare accessible phone status and local audio cancellation controls
details: Add standalone CaneSightStatus/SwiftUI products with explicit unknown, disconnected and narration states, image-column labels, optional 60pt camera controls, large cancel control and accessibility Escape. Preserve original display deadlines and fence late/reentrant callbacks; cancellation uses a synchronous local adapter even offline and reports requests without asserting physical silence. Use accepted CS-017 directly in integration tests after its merge. Host app, speech engine, protocol, hardware and other owners' code remain unchanged. Initial base 5dbb6adc6f7c8984e1beb624fc7c8fe1a4cdfafa; publication base 94ccaaf14a88b990cc468433e55622b0b1e6681f.
validation: 17 portable Swift tests and 2 actual lifecycle integration tests passed on official Swift 6.0.3 in Ubuntu/WSL with strict concurrency and warnings as errors. Six Swift files passed syntax audit. Native SwiftUI/Apple SDK, VoiceOver/layout, actual host/speech path and audible speaker stop remain unrun; keep draft/blocked. Checked publishing runs shared repository/changelog/whitespace validation.
